name: Hunting
overview: Scripture acknowledges hunting as a God-ordained activity, evident from Genesis 9:3 where God permits the consumption of every living creature. Notable biblical figures such as Nimrod are described as mighty hunters before the LORD (Genesis 10:9), while others like Esau and Ishmael actively engaged in hunting for sustenance (Genesis 27:3-5; 21:20). These passages illustrate hunting’s practical role in providing food and demonstrate God’s sovereignty over the natural order, allowing mankind to responsibly utilize His creation.
